description: Sri Lanka Railways - Conducting the Special Election of office bearers as per the Ceylon Railway Daily Paid workers'' Benevolent Association
categorisation: The gazette content announces the approval and results of a special election for office-bearers of the Ceylon Railway Daily Paid Workers' Benevolent Association, a public sector union. This falls under public sector administration, specifically the management of a public service association's internal elections, which is a matter of public service administration and procedure. It does not involve core government structural/personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor does it fit the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Commercial, Elections (national/political), Judicial, or Miscellaneous.
